spans.s:
Sthiraka Gārgya (‘descendant of Garga’) is the name of a
teacher in the Vaṃśa Brāhmaṇa.^1
1) Indische Studien, 4, 373.

Sthivi occurs once (used in the plural) in the Rigveda,^1
probably meaning ‘bushel.’ The word is also found once in
the adjective sthivimant,^2 ‘provided with bushels.’
1) x. 68, 3.
2) Rv. x. 27, 15. Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 238.
